- Improved and restructured documentation for better readability and clarity, including new tables, section breakdowns, and bilingual headings.
- Enhanced description of capability scope, workflow, input/output formats, and user privacy safeguards.
- Clarified the strict requirement to use only cloud APIs for history queries; all manual, local, or memory-based retrieval methods remain forbidden.
- Removed legacy or duplicate documentation files; updated guidance with stricter formatting and stronger compliance with privacy and data access constraints.
- Added an example usage section and highlighted all mandatory constraints and recommendations.

- Major refactor: internal user identity detection is now automated and no longer requires user input or exposure to users.
- Removed all prompts and requirements for users to input or provide open-id/username/phone; identity handled entirely by backend.
- Updated interface and documentation to reflect simplified user workflow (no authentication params needed).
- File reorganization: common/face_analysis code removed; new smyx_analysis module added.
- Clarified maximum input file size limit (10MB), updated command usage and examples.
- License field added to SKILL.md.

- Improved local file saving: all uploaded attachments or photos/videos are now saved as local files.
- Updated historical report table output: links are now extracted from the API JSON response and displayed in a standardized Markdown table.
- Minor clarifications in documentation and process steps.
- No functional changes to detection/analysis logic.

- Improved configuration handling in scripts/config.py for better environment support.
- Updated config-dev.yaml, config-test.yaml, and config.yaml with revised or additional settings.
- Refactored utility code in scripts/util.py to enhance reliability.
- Streamlined __init__.py for consistency.
- No changes to the main user-facing documentation or features.

- Improved configuration parsing and loading logic across face analysis and common scripts for consistency.
- Refactored config and utility scripts to reduce duplication and centralize settings management.
- Updated skill documentation in SKILL.md to clarify API usage, open-id validation flow, and configuration file priorities.
- Enhanced error handling for missing or improperly configured API keys in YAML config files.
- Minor code structure and readability improvements in face analysis and shared modules.

- Initial release of the Contactless Health Risk Detection & Analysis skill.
- Provides early-stage risk screening and alerts for chronic and acute conditions (e.g., heart attack, stroke, hypertension, hyperlipidemia) by analyzing frontal facial images with multimodal physiological features.
- Supports both local image/video uploads and internet video/image URLs for analysis.
- Enforces strict data handling and privacy rules, including prohibition on reading local memory files; all report queries must use the cloud API.
- Requires users to provide an open-id (via config file or direct input) before analysis or report retrieval; operation is paused and prompts the user if open-id is not available.
- Returns structured reports and outputs historical report lists in a Markdown table with direct links to each cloud-based report.
